components.name: AvailabilityScheduler
components.doc: Week grid of one-hour slots: click or drag a rectangle to mark when you are free, apply a preset, and read the result as merged ranges per day.

members.name: includes
members.doc: Whether the slot that starts at `hour` (24 h clock) on `day` (0 is the first column) belongs to the preset.

members.name: value
members.doc: Selected one-hour slots as `"day-hour"` ids: day from 0 (first column), hour on the 24 h clock. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the grid.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Starting selection when uncontrolled. Defaults to weekdays 9 to 5 with a lunch break.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the sorted selection after a click, a drag, a key press or a preset.

members.name: endHour
members.doc: Hour at which the last slot ends (24 h clock).

members.name: presets
members.doc: One-click selections offered above the grid.
